episodes.synopsis: A young man visits a bathhouse. A woman on the other side continually asks him for things, which he finds strange since no one else is in the bathhouse.
episodes.title: Lend It to Me

episodes.synopsis: Two men are travelling and run out of gas in a tunnel.
episodes.title: Tunnel

episodes.synopsis: A young couple moves into an apartment infested with rats and the young lady is bitten by one.
episodes.title: Rat

episodes.synopsis: A man in a hospital notices strange noises coming from a hospital room.
episodes.title: The Noisy Hospital Room

episodes.synopsis: A young couple visits a taxidermy museum.
episodes.title: Museum of Taxidermy

episodes.synopsis: Two girls attend a festival, but something strange happens.
episodes.title: "That Side" Festival

episodes.synopsis: At the Kuchiya Inn, during a school field trip, all of the students are asleep, except for three boys. One of them, Osamu, tells his friends he doesn't want to sleep because he's been having a nightmare recently.
episodes.title: Behind

episodes.synopsis: Two teenage couple visit an abandoned house for a test of courage. They find a set of dolls where the Empress doll is missing.
episodes.title: The Empress Doll

episodes.synopsis: Two high school students run into the handshake men.
episodes.title: The Fourth Man

episodes.synopsis: A young couple are at a mall carnival and the young woman is offered a free ride on the carousel.
episodes.title: Merry-go-round

episodes.synopsis: A young girl visits her grandmother and is obsessed with a cuckoo clock on the wall.
episodes.title: Cuckoo Clock

episodes.synopsis: A boy sneaks into a closed swimming pool.
episodes.title: In the Water

episodes.synopsis: A teacher notices a boy drawing pictures of people who end up missing.
episodes.title: Drawings
